title: Thin and flimsy
text: Thin and flimsy. Price is right but it is thin and flimsy unlike others l have purchased that have more drying power.

product_metadata.title: Drymate XL Dish Drying Mat, Oversized (19”x24”), Low-Profile, Super Absorbent, Quick Dry Fabric, Waterproof & Slip-Resistant, for Kitchen Counter, Trimmable, Machine Washable (USA Made)(Modern)
features: (XL SIZE) KEEPS COUNTERTOPS CLEAN AND DRY (PREMIUM LOW-PROFILE DESIGN): The low-profile design (0.13” thick), adds stability when drying stemware or other delicate items and allows moisture to evaporate quickly. The XL size is great for air-drying dishes, glasses, silverware, pots, pans, and fruits and vegetables.

ABSORBENT POLYESTER FABRIC, WITH WATERPROOF BACKING (SLIP-RESISTANT): Patented Drymate material absorbs and contains liquids and wicks away moisture. The waterproof backing stops liquids from soaking through and prevents them from damaging or staining the surface below. Our slip-resistant backing helps to keep the mat securely in place and prevents it from sliding around.

PROTECTS COUNTERTOPS FROM SCRATCHES, SCUFFS, AND SPILLS: Our mat protects your counters by providing a protection layer when placed under a dish rack, pots, pans, dishware, and glassware. It also protects under small appliances such as a mixer, blender, or coffee maker.
UNIVERSAL/CUSTOM FIT: Our material can be easily cut to fit with scissors and the edges will not fray or split. Combine multiple mats to fit any countertop space and under any dish drying rack.

EASY TO CLEAN, WASHABLE, DURABLE (MADE IN THE USA): Machine washable or simply scrub with soap, rinse off and hang dry. Do not bleach. This mat is durable, lightweight, and long-lasting. Proudly made in the USA! Phthalate and BPA free. Made from over 50% recycled fibers.
